label: final 1-2 copy-phase steps (end of copy)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never during original tokens or at <DEL>), and only near the end of the copy: 64% of activation mass is on the final output step (to_go==0), 25% on the second-to-last, ~8% at to_go==2, essentially none earlier. Largest activations are on the last step of L=3 sequences (input = orig token 1, e.g. d 3 m <DEL> d [3]). It never fires on the first occurrence of a token (in_first==0 always, a consequence of being in the copy phase). Within the final steps it fires on only about 27% of them, with a moderate preference for certain input tokens (l, 3, r, g, z, n, 2, j) and output tokens (c, z, 1, 3, q). Adding those token sets raises precision to ~0.54 but drops recall to ~0.45 (F1 ~0.49), so the token dependence is not captured cleanly. The positional predicate covers ~89% of mass but has low precision.
